items.hyp: Tonakgolo ya Bosetšhaba le Matlole (COGTA), Naledi ya setlhopha ya ga Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a lebanwa kwa mmasepala wa go tlhagelela ga moporesidente wa mmosepala wa ga Winnie Madikizela Mandela.
items.ref: Tona ya Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), Ngk Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tsenetse moletlo o wa semmuso wa go fetola leina la Mbizana go nna Mmasepala wa selegae wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Mmueledi wa mmasepala Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa Mafumbatha a re go na le diporopegwe tse di tshwanang le go netefatsa gore batho ba lefatshe ba tshwanetse go bontsha ditshwanelo tsa bone.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha a re go tlhomiwa ga go tlhomiwa ga mafaratlhatlha go tlhoma batho ba ba latelang.

items.hyp: Winnie Madikizela Mandela o ne a le maikaelelo a a neng a sa kgatholositsweng gore go tlhagisa mmasepala a gagwe go ralala go se ka nako e bile gape re a tlhalosa ka legafo la ga ga Winnie.
items.ref: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela o ne a le mogaka wa boditšhabatšhaba jaanong go reela mmasepala ka leina la gagwe go tlile go dira gore tlhabololo ya rona e gole ka bonako, mme gape re bua ka boswa jwa Mme Winnie.
